description: Lists the webinar campaigns of the connected WordPress site: id, title, type (live or automated, evergreen), status, the real start (date, time, timezone, duration), whether it repeats, and the page address. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved. Use it when the host asks which webinars exist, what runs next, or which campaign a number belongs to. Do not use it for registrants or money (that is wi_list_webinar_leads_registrants and wi_get_webinar_revenue_woocommerce). Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

limit.description: How many webinars to return, 1-200. Default 50, newest first.

offset.description: Skip this many of the newest webinars, to walk a long list in pages.

search.description: Narrow the list: an exact campaign id, or part of the title the host sees.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

name: wi_list_webinars
title: List your webinars
